info.name: Renivet Backend - Brand Taxonomy Reads (REN2-59)
info.description: Runnable examples for brand category tree, current attributes and exact published schema reads. Requires a local brand with catalog.read and a first-party session. Synthetic defaults only. Linear: REN2-59.

request.description: Purpose: retrieve category nodes and current schema metadata. Linear: REN2-59. Parameters: brandId is the brand UUID; optional cursor and limit page the stable tree. Body: none. Authentication/permissions: first-party session and live brand catalog.read permission. Responses: 200 page with ETag; 304 matching If-None-Match; 400 invalid cursor/page; 401 missing session; 403 denied; 503 storage unavailable. Inactive and non-leaf nodes are informational and cannot be selected for submission.

exec: pm.test('tree succeeds or returns a documented authorization denial', function () { pm.expect([200, 304, 400, 401, 403, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('tree includes parent, leaf and current version metadata', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('items'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('ETag')).to.equal(true); });

request.description: Purpose: page typed rules from the current published snapshot. Linear: REN2-59. Parameters: brandId and categoryId are UUIDs; optional cursor is bound to the current schema version. Body: none. Authentication/permissions: first-party session and live brand catalog.read permission. Responses: 200 page with ETag; 304 matching If-None-Match; 400 invalid/stale cursor; 401 missing session; 403 denied; 404 category missing; 503 storage unavailable. Restart pagination after publication.

exec: pm.test('attributes succeed or return a documented authorization/state denial', function () { pm.expect([200, 304, 400, 401, 403, 404, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('typed attribute page includes items', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('items'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('ETag')).to.equal(true); });

item.name: Get exact published category schema version

request.description: Purpose: retrieve the exact immutable schema version without substituting latest. Linear: REN2-59. Parameters: brandId/categoryId are UUIDs and schemaVersion is a positive integer. Body: none. Authentication/permissions: first-party session and live brand catalog.read permission. Responses: 200 exact published version with ETag; 304 matching If-None-Match; 400 invalid path; 401 missing session; 403 denied; 404 unpublished/missing version; 503 storage unavailable.

exec: pm.test('exact version succeeds or returns a documented authorization/state denial', function () { pm.expect([200, 304, 400, 401, 403, 404, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('requested exact published version is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().version).to.equal(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('schemaVersion'))); pm.expect(pm.response.json().state).to.equal('PUBLISHED'); });
